blocks.h: Questions validation and quality teams ask

items.a: No water system is. USP and Ph. Eur. set limits for water, not approvals for equipment. Compliance is water at your points of use that meets the monograph, measured on qualified instruments, with the records behind it. We prove function at FAT and performance on your feed water at SAT and OQ, and support your PQ.

items.q: Do you design to USP or Ph. Eur.?
items.a: To the stricter value on each attribute when your products ship to both: USP <645> stage 1 for PW conductivity, Ph. Eur. 0008 for nitrates, 0.50 mg/L TOC validated for both. The functional specification names the monographs and editions that apply. The contract manufacturing page sets out each attribute side by side.

items.q: Which edition of each standard do you design to?
items.a: The edition in force when you approve the functional specification, named there with your markets, corporate standard and province. When a text changes during a project, as Ph. Eur. 0008 did in Ph. Eur. 12.3 from 1 July 2026, we assess it under change control and tell you whether it touches the design, the tests or neither.

items.q: Is your control system 21 CFR Part 11 compliant?
items.a: No system is compliant on its own; your site is, by technical controls in the system plus procedures. We supply the technical controls (audit trail, access control, electronic signatures, record protection and backups) and a written Part 11 and Annex 11 assessment your quality unit can review.

items.q: Who registers our pressure equipment, and when?
items.a: Pressure vessels and fittings installed in Canada need a CRN under CSA B51 from the province of installation; in some provinces piping systems do too. Registration sits in the schedule from the start, because a design built for another market may need changes first. [Aquemi CRN process and provinces covered]

items.q: Does our corporate engineering standard replace yours?
items.a: It adds to this list. Send it with the URS: we add it to the standards list in the functional specification and flag any clause that conflicts with a standard here, so your team decides before detailed design, not at IQ.

items.q: Do you build device and laboratory water systems?
items.a: Device rinse water is traced to the USP <161> endotoxin limit: 20.0 EU per device, 2.15 EU for cerebrospinal fluid contact. Steam for ISO 17665 sterilization is tested to EN 285. Hospital reprocessing water (CSA Z314, ANSI/AAMI ST108:2023): [scope for hospital MDRD water]. Laboratory water (ASTM D1193): [scope for laboratory water].

items.q: Will you complete our supplier questionnaire?
items.a: Send it with the request for proposal. [returned with the quote, yes or no]; turnaround [questionnaire turnaround, working days]. The quality management page shows how we control materials, welding, calibration and change.
